review_description: Very pleased with the quoting processThey arrived on time, the installation went smoothly, Stuart and his team from Top Power Electrical Pty Ltd did a very good job.Customer service met my expectations, Stuart organised the grid connection and at my request he has agreed to come back out later this week to explain how to set up my "App'.I would recommend this installer.Baden

(Please note: I already had a quote from Top Power Electrical when I asked for recommendation from 2 more installers). I chose Top Power Electrical because of personal recommendations - the company has a good reputation in my local area. Stuart and the team turned up on time, they are a well-oiled team, working well together and they are good communicators. The panels were installed quickly and efficiently, all connections to the internet made using Enphase inverters. They also organised connection to the grid. So far I am very happy with the installation, but it's too early to tell how it will perform in the long run.

Quoting process was easy,  Stuart took all my requests on board and suggested good solutions for our complicated system (which wasn't complicated once he was finished) making sure we retained our 3 phase system.On the day of installation,  the team arrived early and didn't muck around,  before i knew it,  the system was up.  They then made sure they tidied up any rubbish and left the site in the same codifying as when they arrived.Stuart then explained the system to me,  showed me through the app and answered any questions i had.  All interactions with Stuart and the other electricians installing (and they were electricians) were friendly,  polite and respectful.I highly recommend Top Power Electrical
All aspects of the purchase of our solar panels has been great. So far the panels are working fantastically and will be well sufficient for our household needs now and in the future.

Stuart was a great communicator throughout the entire process. He took the time to come and inspect our property and followed up after he left. We wanted to support a local installer and we're glad we did. The team showed up on time, installed a great system, explained and answered all of our questions and were professional and friendly. I'll recommend Stuart and his team to anybody who asks.

Top Power have only recently signed up to Solar Quotes, and so had NO reviews when I chose to go with them. It was a risk that paid off handsomely.The whole process was incredibly smooth and efficient with our 11.1 kW system, plus Tesla Powerwall installed and up and running within one day. Stuart handled everything very professionally and took me through how the monitoring ap works so I feel confident that we can get the best out of the system. He answered all of my questions and guided me through to my final choice of the system that meets our needs.Attention to detail was impressive, right down to the effort put in to making the trench (from the panel install on the shed back to the house) as unobtrusive as possible. I am a very satisfied customer.
